observations.expected: Bomb reaches moving target, Exact trace hit is counted and HUD reports the result.

observations.action: At simulation frame 180 paused before requesting round-1 save; closed process; relaunched with TB_LOAD_SLOT=round-1 and TB_START_PAUSED=1.
observations.expected: Round state and paused simulation restore in a new process.
observations.actual: Save slot exists; second process exit 0; loaded-round log reports elapsed=2.98333, hits=1, misses=0, units=5 and simulation=0.

observations.action: project.input: Play, focus, 130 frames, Pause, 10 frames, Resume, 10 frames, Stop; 150 total frames.
observations.expected: Actual Play-session game update should release/hit the automatic bomb; pause holds state and resume proceeds.
observations.actual: Pre-fix reproduction was BUG-R6-003: Play/focus/130/Pause/10/Resume/10/Stop returned exit 0, but no bomb or hit; Bomber.Unit.1 remained at its start position. Coordinator fixed SceneEditSession simulation state and render/tick ownership. Rebuilt BomberUpgrade using explicit current Runtime SDK. Exact same request on current EngineCommandlets exit 0/150 frames: bomb released t=1.008s and HIT unit id=7 t=1.936s, trace=Hit, 60 queries/28 triangles. Unit.1 moved from [-6,0.42,-2] to [-4.655859,0.42,-1.782786]; 10 paused frames produced 0 movement; after Resume it moved 0.05343.

observations.action: Parameterized render.transparency with cross/self-intersecting skeletal and crowd/VAT surfaces, camera orbit, animation time, LOD, and frame resize, in Forward and Deferred.
observations.expected: GPU captures render layers and animation during camera motion; resize and LOD state respond.
observations.actual: After the r6 fix, the current rebuilt Runtime commandlet was rerun: Forward and Deferred each exit 0, ok=true, four 320x256/640x360 frames on RTX 4070. Forward drawCalls 183,133,133,183; Deferred 184,134,134,184. Crowd LOD bucket counts changed from [2,2,0] to [2,0,0] as orbit/distance changed. Current Forward capture was visually inspected and shows intersecting colored semitransparent planes. No independent pixel oracle was run; state is GPU capture pass, not full numerical correctness.

observations.action: Parameterized render.point-shadows with animated skeletal caster, moving point light, shadows off/on, and restored initial frame.
observations.expected: Shadow cube responds to caster/light motion; off removes cube; repeating initial state restores same map.
observations.actual: After the r6 fix, current rebuilt Runtime `render.point-shadows` was rerun: exit 0 on RTX 4070. Animated skeletal caster/light movement, shadows off, restored frame produced cube counts 1,1,0,1 and slots 0,0,-1,0; moving-frame face hashes changed and restored initial hashes match. Inspected current BMP shows caster and point-light shadow on receiver. This is hidden GPU commandlet/BMP evidence, not visible editor A/B.
